provenance: WHO/EMEP-EEA air pollutant emission inventory guidebook — fleet-average CO2 band for mixed urban LDV+PUV fleets (planning excerpt for MATRIX ECO-1 spot-check; not a full EMEP table dump).
note: Band covers typical urban Philippines mixed fleet averages used as planning norms (≈110–160 g/km). ECO-1's 120 g/km fleet average must sit inside this band.
